records.clean_Japanese: 丸くて小さな盾。非常に堅く、かつ青色をした不思議な樫の木から作られている。

records.localization_note: Retain the natural compact description. It keeps both the unusual wood and the shape of the shield.

records.clean_Japanese: 大きなアルマジロの皮から作った盾。非常に軽いうえ、鉄にも優る堅さを誇る。

records.clean_Japanese: 目出し用スリットの入った兜。表面が銀箔で覆われており、美しく輝いている。

records.clean_Japanese: 一部がくちばしのようにとがった兜。羽ばたく鳥の姿を表した飾りは、死をも恐れぬ精神を表現している。
records.current_English: A beak-pointed helm whose flying-bird crest symbolizes fearlessness even in death.

records.localization_note: Make the two design features clear and preserve the meaning of the bird crest.

records.clean_Japanese: 巨大なゾウガメの甲羅を使って盾を作ったもの。生半可な鉱石などより、はるかに強固にできている。

records.source_meaning: A shield fashioned from the shell of a giant tortoise, much stronger than one made of ordinary mineral material.

records.clean_Japanese: 着ると、不思議と心が温まる純白のドレス。身に着けた者には精霊の加護が宿るという伝説がある。

records.source_meaning: A pure white dress that mysteriously warms the heart of the wearer. Legend says the protection of spirits comes to the person who wears it.

records.clean_Japanese: 軽くて強靱な武道着。斬りつけた相手の剣の刃を折ってしまう。

records.clean_Japanese: 通気性に優れた鎧。これを着た者は清涼感を覚えるという。強度もかなりのもの。

records.clean_Japanese: アフリカ中部で１１世紀に栄えた国、カネムの戦士たちが用いていた強固な盾。

records.clean_Japanese: 怪しげな迷信に陥った騎士が着ていたという鎧。デザインの趣味は相当に悪い。
records.current_English: Very tasteless armor of a knight lost in superstition, they say.

records.source_meaning: Armor said to have been worn by a knight in the grip of a dubious superstition. Its design is in extremely poor taste.

records.clean_Japanese: リングをつなぎ合わせて強度を増した鎧。かつて戦闘中に赤色に輝き、着ていた騎士が神に護られたという伝説が残る。

prior_private_rows: Linked rings reinforce this armor. Legend says

records.source_item_name: ティムールの鎖かたびら

prior_private_rows: Timur of the 14th-century Timurid Empire wore

records.context: Armor description read under the item title in the standalone card and main detail screen.

records.source_meaning: A practical suit of chainmail designed above all for use. It is a little heavy. Timur, ruler of the Timurid Empire, which flourished in the fourteenth century, wore it.
records.localization_note: Restore Timur’s role and preserve the practical design and weight in a single catalogue sentence.

records.clean_Japanese: 背中に孔雀の羽を差した、派手なかたびら。美しく人目を引くが、強度は劣る。実用性より目立つことを優先させて作ったもの。
records.current_English: Showy mail with peacock feathers on its back. Beautiful but weak, it favors spectacle over protection.
prior_private_rows: Showy mail with peacock feathers on its back.

protection.
records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: Armor description read under the item title in the standalone card and main detail screen.

records.source_meaning: Flashy mail with peacock feathers on the back. It is beautiful and striking, but less sturdy. It was made to stand out more than to be practical.
records.localization_note: Keep the creator’s priorities clear and avoid turning the comparative strength into a claim that the mail is weak.

records.clean_Japanese: 伝説の兜。古代アステカのトゥーラ戦士が、戦闘時にかぶって勇気を奮い立たせたといわれる。

records.localization_note: Keep the helmet as something the warriors used to summon courage and keep the source’s cultural labels.

records.clean_Japanese: 東洋の忍者が用いている黒装束。動きやすくて目立ちにくい、素晴らしい防具。

records.source_item_name: カール・マルテルの甲冑
